newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on fund buying.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Tuesday, lifted by fund buying late, traders said.
"We were really slow but then Refco came in and we hit some stops," one floor source said.
Traders said Refco bought at least 125 to 150 lots of September while Lind-Waldock bought 100 lots, split between the September and November.
The market paid little attention to USDA's weekly crop update which showed 46 percent of the crop was headed as of Sunday, compared with 52 percent average.
World weather continued to garner attention.

Traders noted outlooks for dry weather in the Philippines, a major rice producer and consumer. The Philippine weather bureau said on Tuesday it expected below-average rainfall over the next two months due to the El Nino phenomenon.
Rice ended five to two cents per cwt higher with September up 4-1/2 at $9.77-1/2. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 600 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 594.
